units.source_text: 枕头边并排放着水壶、油灯和烧酒的瓶。

en.t: Beside the pillow, a water jug, an oil lamp, and a bottle of shochu were set out in a row.

units.source_text: 他赶忙撑起手肘，猛吸了一口水，又把水对准地炉喷吐过去。

en.t: He hurriedly propped himself up on one elbow, gulped a mouthful of water, then spat it toward the sunken hearth.

units.source_text: 然后慢慢地，边品尝滋味边润湿喉咙。

en.t: Then, slowly, savoring the taste as he did, he moistened his throat.

units.source_text: 往油灯边上一摸，碰到一个柔软的小包，里边放着火柴和香烟。

en.t: When he felt beside the oil lamp, his hand touched a soft little bundle with matches and cigarettes inside.

units.source_text: 他点亮油灯，燃起香烟，喝了口烧酒，在嘴里轻轻地含漱了一下。

en.t: He lit the oil lamp, lit a cigarette, took a sip of shochu, and lightly rinsed it around in his mouth.

units.source_text: 乱七八糟的意识，渐渐地清晰起来。

en.t: His jumbled consciousness gradually began to clear.
